confidence_definition: Maximum returned choice probability; uncalibrated decision score.

intent.instructions: Identify what the shopper wants to do in this store-assistance conversation.

criteria.find_item: Ask to locate or search for a product in the store.
criteria.select_item: Choose one product or option from results already shown.
criteria.repeat_directions: Ask to repeat walking directions for an already selected item.
criteria.out_of_scope: Request something other than finding store products, choosing a shown result, or repeating walking directions.
